scope: 16 individually selectable pose/expression additions across 10 identities and four stories; existing works not automatically changed
selectionReason: Prioritize Heungbu wives (2 variants each), Onggojib wife/mother/youngest daughter, fairy/woodcutter actions rather than standing-only expressions, and rabbit/turtle/physician interaction gestures. Raw story count is not treated as coverage.

recipes.name: 흥부 아내
recipes.label: 반갑게 맞이하기
recipes.pose: Warm relieved smile, one open hand extended in welcome, other hand near chest. Standing full body; no props.

recipes.name: 흥부 아내
recipes.label: 단호하게 말하기
recipes.pose: Compassionate but firm serious expression, one palm open at waist making a clear reasoned argument, other hand held near waist. Standing.

recipes.name: 놀부 아내
recipes.label: 고개 숙여 사과하기
recipes.pose: Eyes lowered in remorse, gentle apologetic bow from the waist, hands respectfully together at waist. Standing with natural modest bend, not kneeling.

recipes.name: 놀부 아내
recipes.label: 밥그릇 건네기
recipes.pose: Kind tentative smile, both hands offering a small plain earthenware bowl of cooked white rice forward. Standing; preserve bowl as opaque white rice, gaps around arms transparent.

recipes.name: 선녀
recipes.label: 마음을 설명하기
recipes.pose: Earnest determined expression, one hand on chest and other extended palm-up explaining personal feelings, full body standing, no props.

recipes.name: 선녀
recipes.label: 다정하게 위로하기
recipes.pose: Warm empathetic smile with concerned soft brows; leaning slightly forward, one open hand extended at shoulder height to comfort someone outside image; other hand near chest. Only this one character.

recipes.name: 나무꾼
recipes.label: 고개 숙여 사과하기
recipes.pose: Sincere remorseful expression, eyes lowered, respectful bow from waist with hands together in front. Full body, natural adult proportions. No axe.

recipes.name: 나무꾼
recipes.label: 장작 패기
recipes.pose: Working action: standing feet apart, both hands on a wooden-handled iron axe angled down toward a small log on a chopping stump. Controlled safe preparation pose, no swinging motion lines. Full single character and axe and stump; no scene or soil platform.

recipes.name: 토끼
recipes.label: 머쓱하게 사과하기
recipes.pose: Same unclothed anthropomorphic rabbit, ears slightly lowered, sheepish apologetic expression, small respectful bow, both paws together at chest. Full body and ears.

recipes.name: 토끼
recipes.label: 손 내밀어 위로하기
recipes.pose: Same unclothed rabbit, soft empathetic expression and gentle smile, one paw extended open toward someone outside image, other paw near chest. Full body, only rabbit.

recipes.name: 자라
recipes.label: 감사 인사하기
recipes.pose: Relieved grateful warm smile, gentle respectful bow, both hands together in front of blue robe. Keep exact hat, robe, shell and pouch; full body, no extra objects.

recipes.name: 어의
recipes.label: 약재 살펴보기
recipes.pose: Thoughtful focused physician, head tilted slightly down inspecting one small medicinal leaf held gently in a clawed hand, other hand holding closed brown medical book. Preserve exact elderly dragon anatomy and outfit. No medicine bowl; full body.

recipes.name: 옹고집 아내
recipes.label: 안도하며 웃기
recipes.pose: Warm clearly relieved smile, one hand over heart and other relaxed at waist, shoulders relaxed. Full body standing; no tears or props.

recipes.name: 옹고집 아내
recipes.label: 손을 들어 말리기
recipes.pose: Concerned firm expression, one arm extended with open palm in a calm stop gesture, other hand near waist; urging restraint, not angry shouting. Full body standing.

recipes.name: 옹고집 어머니
recipes.label: 타이르며 말하기
recipes.pose: Same elderly mother, kind but serious admonishing expression, slightly hunched elderly posture, one hand raised with open palm at chest explaining gently; other hand holding own sleeve at waist. Full body standing.

recipes.name: 옹고집 막내
recipes.label: 눈물 닦기
recipes.pose: Same young daughter at her exact child age and proportions, visibly sad but gentle child-friendly expression, a small tear on cheek, one hand wiping eye with sleeve, other hand near chest. Full body standing, no other characters.
